title: 12 South Charmer 3 bedroom with Rooftop Patio
description:
Hey friends! We are excited to welcome you to this gorgeous  Home located in the best area of Nashville ! 
Walk to 12South,  The Gulch or ride less than a mile to downtown, Belmont, and Vanderbilt. This house is a rare gem - 3 bedrooms with 2 full baths and 1/2 ,  spacious rooms with high ceilings,  beautiful views, large walk-in closets, washer/dryer,  fireplace, outdoor areas to enjoy on the rooftop with a view of downtown, two living areas  and all the amenities of home .

The space
- Huge 2,643 SQF luxurious  townhouse with AMAZING Nashville Skyline view ROOFTOP. Fireplace 
-  3 bedrooms, 2.5 Bathrooms
- Fully equipped kitchen, 3 smart TV's, stunning main bathroom, 1 garages
- BREATHTAKING rooftop for unforgettable moments - smart TV, comfortable patio furniture everything you need to enjoy your stay in music city!

Guest access
You will have full access of the home during your stay as well as a garage if needed.

Other things to note
We are in an urban area you may hear the sites and sounds of the city during your stay. 
We give you start up supplies to get you settled till you can go to the store additional supplies are your responsibility as you are a longer stay guest.
